Fiji Declares National HIV Emergency Amidst Rising Cases

Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency due to a surge in cases, with one in every 60 people now reportedly living with the virus. The government is expanding testing efforts to address the outbreak. Reports suggest a drug crisis is fueling the rise in HIV infections.
